# Referral voucher and merchant credit UI/UX (2026-01-20 19:42Z)

_**User**_

You are Cursor acting as a senior product designer + frontend engineer.
Your task is to implement a premium, modern, global-ready UI/UX for a
“Referral Voucher + Merchant Credit” platform.

The UI must feel:
- trustworthy like Stripe
- simple like Notion
- energetic like modern fintech / creator tools
- merchant-first, not marketplace-like

This is NOT a coupon site.
This is a merchant-powered referral infrastructure.

==================================================
1) DESIGN PHILOSOPHY (LOCKED)
==================================================

- Web-first, mobile-native
- Clean, minimal, no clutter
- High contrast, accessible
- Motion used only to explain state or reward action
- No skeuomorphism, no fake gamification

Key principles:
- 1 primary action per screen
- Never block sharing behind login
- Everything important visible in <3 seconds
- “Earned value” must FEEL earned

==================================================
2) COLOR & THEME SYSTEM
==================================================

Base theme (platform default):
- Background: near-white or soft gray
- Surface cards: white
- Text: near-black (not pure black)
- Accent: neutral brand color (platform-level)

Merchant theming:
- Each voucher page inherits merchant brand:
  - primary color
  - optional secondary
  - logo
- Apply brand color to:
  - CTA buttons
  - highlights
  - progress indicators
- Never recolor text for brand if it hurts readability

Dark mode:
- Supported
- Same hierarchy, no neon

==================================================
3) TYPOGRAPHY
==================================================

- Primary font: modern sans (Inter / Geist / equivalent)
- Clear hierarchy:
  - Page title: strong, calm
  - Section headers: subtle
  - Meta text: muted
- Numbers (credits, %):
  - slightly heavier weight
  - visually separated

No playful fonts.
No marketing fluff typography.

==================================================
4) LAYOUT SYSTEM
==================================================

- Max width for content (e.g. 1200px)
- Card-based structure
- Consistent spacing (8pt grid)
- Mobile-first layouts:
  - stacked
  - thumb-friendly CTAs
- Desktop enhances, never redesigns flow

==================================================
5) CORE SCREENS – UI BEHAVIOR
==================================================

A) Voucher Landing Page (Public, MOST IMPORTANT)

Goal: instant trust + instant share.

Must include:
- Merchant logo + name
- Voucher headline (big, clear)
- Value clearly visible (% / €)
- Expiry / limits (small but clear)
- Primary CTA: “Get this voucher”
- Secondary CTA: “Share with a friend”

Share action:
- Opens native share sheet on mobile
- Copy link fallback
- QR visible but not dominant

Visual:
- Branded card
- Slight elevation
- No clutter
- No login wall

--------------------------------------------------

B) Referral Landing (Friend View)

Goal: redeem confidence.

Must include:
- “You got a voucher from [Name]”
- Voucher card
- Redeem options:
  - “Use online”
  - “Show QR in store”
- Clear “No app required” feeling

--------------------------------------------------

C) User Wallet (Credits)

Goal: make credit feel valuable.

UI rules:
- Show total available credit BIG
- Locked credit visually separated
- Expiry dates visible but subtle
- One clear CTA: “Use credit”

Use:
- Progress bars for “unlocking”
- Success animation when credit unlocks (subtle)

--------------------------------------------------

D) Merchant Dashboard

Goal: control without overwhelm.

Dashboard:
- KPI cards (Today / Week)
- Active vouchers
- Redemptions
- Credit issued

Voucher list:
- Status chips (Active / Paused / Draft)
- Usage bars
- Quick actions (Pause / Duplicate)

--------------------------------------------------

E) Voucher Builder (Key Differentiator)

Layout:
- Left: controls
- Center: live preview
- Right (optional): rules & conditions

Controls:
- Logo upload
- Background (color / image)
- Headline
- Subtext
- Fine print
- Auto QR + code

Preview:
- Mobile-first
- Toggle desktop view
- Exactly what end-user sees

No Canva-level complexity.
Simple, fast, controlled.

==================================================
6) COMPONENT DESIGN RULES
==================================================

Buttons:
- Primary: solid, confident
- Secondary: outline or subtle fill
- Destructive: rare, clear

States:
- Hover: slight elevation or shade
- Active: firm press
- Disabled: obvious, no tricks
- Loading: inline spinner, no page blocking

Forms:
- Short
- Inline validation
- No walls of inputs

Tables:
- Clean
- Zebra optional
- Sticky headers where useful

==================================================
7) MOTION & MICRO-INTERACTIONS
==================================================

Allowed:
- Voucher claimed success
- Credit unlocked
- Weekly drop opened
- Share action feedback

Rules:
- 150–250ms
- Ease-out
- Never bounce
- Never distract

==================================================
8) MOBILE UX (CRITICAL)
==================================================

- Thumb-zone CTAs
- Bottom-aligned primary actions
- No tiny tap targets
- Share button always visible
- QR large enough to scan easily

PWA:
- Looks like native
- No browser chrome dependency
- Offline QR if already opened

==================================================
9) ACCESSIBILITY
==================================================

- WCAG AA contrast
- Keyboard navigable
- Screen reader labels
- No color-only meaning

==================================================
10) WHAT TO AVOID (IMPORTANT)
==================================================

DO NOT:
- Look like a coupon aggregator
- Push signup before value
- Use fake urgency timers
- Use loud colors
- Over-brand the platform over merchants

==================================================
11) SUCCESS CRITERIA
==================================================

- First-time user understands value in <5 seconds
- Voucher shared in 1 tap
- Merchant can create voucher without tutorial
- UI feels premium, not “startup cheap”
- Works equally well on:
  - Android
  - iPhone
  - Desktop

==================================================
FINAL INSTRUCTION
==================================================

Design and implement this UI using shadcn/ui, Tailwind, and modern React patterns.
Prioritize clarity, speed, and trust.
This UI should make merchants proud to send their customers here.

Build it.


---

_**Agent (model default, mode Agent)**_

Exploring the codebase to map structure, stack, and existing UI before we plan and implement.

Kokkuvõte tehtud muudatustest:

---

## Tehtud muudatused

### 1. **Referral Landing (r/[id])** – `referral-client.tsx`
- **"You got a voucher from [Name]"** üleval
- Voucherikaart: bränd, pealkiri, väärtus, kood
- **"No app required — use in browser"** ikooniga
- **"Use online"** (summa) ja **"Show QR in store"** (pärast tegevust keritakse QR-i juurde)
- QR 200×200, selge tekst: "Show this QR at the register"
- `alert` asendatud `showSuccess` toastidega

### 2. **Wallet** – `app/[merchantSlug]/wallet/page.tsx`
- **Available** suure number (4xl–5xl) ja üks selge CTA: **"Use credit"** → `/app/{slug}/checkout-demo`
- **Locked** eraldi kaardil (dashed, muted) + "Unlocks when the linked purchase is confirmed"
- Ajalugu: summa, staatus, expiry väiksema rõhuga

### 3. **Merchant Dashboard** – `merchant/[slug]/dashboard/page.tsx`
- KPI-kaardid: **Today**, **This week** (redemptions `createdAt`), Active vouchers, Total redemptions, Credit issued
- Pending confirmations eraldi hoiatuskaardina
- Kiirtegevused grid’is

### 4. **Voucher list** – `merchant/[slug]/vouchers/page.tsx` + `voucher-row-actions.tsx`
- **Badge** staatile: Active (roheline), Paused (kollane), Draft, Ended (muted)
- **Usage bar** kui on `usageLimitTotal`; muul juhul "Unlimited"
- **Pause** (ainult published) ja **Duplicate** (GET + POST) client-komponendis

### 5. **Voucher Builder (new)** – `merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx`
- **Layout:** vasak – 3 sammu (Type & value, Weekly drop, Design), paremal **sticky live preview** (lg); mobiilil preview step 3 all
- **Preview:** pealkiri, väärtus, kehtivus, fine print; värvid `formData`-st
- **designJson** ja **weeklyDropJson** saadetakse objektidena (API stringify endale)
- **alert** → `showError` toast

---

## Build

Build katkeb tõrkele, mida meie muudatused ei põhjustanud:

**`app/api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]/route.ts`** – `weeklyDropJson: null` ei sobi Prisma tüübile. Prisma puhul tuleks `null` asemel kasutada `Prisma.JsonNull`:

```ts
// Kui tahetakse Json välja tühjendada:
if (data.weeklyDropJson !== undefined) {
  updateData.weeklyDropJson = data.weeklyDropJson ? JSON.stringify(data.weeklyDropJson) : Prisma.JsonNull;
}
```

Soovitav on see parandada otse `route.ts`-is; `voucher-row-actions` kasutab ainult `{ status: 'paused' }` ja ei puutu sellesse ossa.

---

## Kuidas testida

1. **Voucher (/v/[id]):** ava avaldatud voucher → "Get this voucher", "Share with a friend", QR, Print.
2. **Referral (/r/[id]):** ava referral link → "You got a voucher from…", "Use online" / "Show QR in store", "No app required", QR.
3. **Wallet:** `/app/{merchantSlug}/wallet` → suur available, locked eraldi, "Use credit" → checkout-demo.
4. **Dashboard:** `/merchant/{slug}/dashboard` → Today / This week, active vouchers, pending, quick actions.
5. **Vouchers:** `/merchant/{slug}/vouchers` → status chip, usage bar, Pause (ikoon), Duplicate (ikoon).
6. **Builder:** `/merchant/{slug}/vouchers/new` → 3 sammu, paremal (või step 3 all) live preview; lõpuks Create voucher.

---

_**User**_

täiusta järgmiste sammudega

---

_**Agent (model default, mode Agent)**_

Parandame eelmise töö jääkpunktid: API Prisma.JsonNull tõrge ja võimalikud viimistlused.

## Tehtud muudatused

### 1. **Prisma Json-väljad (build fix)**
- **`app/api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/route.ts`** (POST): `weeklyDropJson`, `conditionsJson`, `designJson` – `null` asendatud `Prisma.DbNull`-ga.
- **`app/api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]/route.ts`** (PUT): sama `Prisma.DbNull` kasutusele; eemaldatud kasutamata `ensureMerchantOwnership` import.

### 2. **`<img>` → `next/image`**
- **`app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx`**: kaubamärgi logo → `Image` (width=160, height=40, `unoptimized`).
- **`app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx`**: sama logo → `Image`.
- **`app/m/[slug]/page.tsx`**: kaubamärgi logo → `Image` (width=200, height=96, `unoptimized`).

Build õnnestus (exit code 0). Tehtud muudatused:

---

## Parandused

### 1. **lib/auth.ts** – Apple provider
- `teamId` ja `keyId` eemaldatud `AppleProvider` seadistusest (Auth.js/Next-Auth v5 toetab ainult `clientId` ja `clientSecret`; `clientSecret` peab olema valmis JWT).
- Tingimus: Apple on sees ainult siis, kui on `APPLE_CLIENT_ID` ja `APPLE_CLIENT_SECRET`.

### 2. **app/api/export/redemptions/route.ts** – staatiline render
- Lisatud `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'`, et Next.js ei püüaks seda API route’i staatiliselt build’i ajal (`auth()` kasutab `headers`).

### 3. **app/[locale]/layout.tsx** – next-intl staatiline render
- `setRequestLocale(params.locale)` layouti algusesse, et lubada staatiline render locale-lehtedel.
- `setRequestLocale` imporditud `next-intl/server`-ist.

### 4. **app/layout.tsx** – themeColor
- `themeColor` võetud `metadata` seest.
- Lisatud `export const viewport = { themeColor: "#ffffff" }`.

---

## Failid

| Fail | Muudatus |
|------|----------|
| `lib/auth.ts` | Apple: `teamId`, `keyId` eemaldatud; tingimus ainult `APPLE_CLIENT_ID` + `APPLE_CLIENT_SECRET` |
| `app/api/export/redemptions/route.ts` | `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` |
| `app/[locale]/layout.tsx` | `setRequestLocale(params.locale)` |
| `app/layout.tsx` | `themeColor` → `viewport` |

---

## Kuidas kontrollida

- `npm run build` – build lõpeb exit code 0.
- Apple login: töötab, kui `APPLE_CLIENT_SECRET` on juba JWT (genereeritud nt `npx auth add apple` või oma skriptiga `APPLE_TEAM_ID`, `APPLE_KEY_ID` ja privaatvõtmega).

**Märkus:** `getRequestConfig` deprecation ja „locale is expected to be returned” on next-intl hoiatused; build’i ei kata. Tuleviku jaoks võib `i18n.ts` üle viia `await requestLocale` ja tagastada `locale` konfigist.

`cmd /c`-ga build õnnestus. PowerShelli Execution Policy blokeerib `npm.ps1`; selle ümberminekuks on kaks võimalust.

---

## 1. Käivita npm läbi cmd (ilma poliitikat muutmata)

PowerShellis:
```powershell
cmd /c "npm run build"
```

Teiste käskude jaoks:
```powershell
cmd /c "npm run dev"
cmd /c "npm start"
```

---

## 2. Luba skripte ainult praegusele kasutajale (püsiv lahendus)

PowerShell **Administratorina** (või kui organisatsioon seda lubab):

```powershell
Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope CurrentUser
```

Pärast seda töötavad tavalised `npm run build` ja `npm run dev` ka PowerShellis.

**RemoteSigned** tähendab: kohalikud `.ps1` (sh `npm.ps1`) käivituvad, allalaaditud skriptid peavad olema allkirjastatud.

---

## Kui `Set-ExecutionPolicy` on keelatud (GPO / tööarvuti)

- Kasuta järjepidevalt `cmd /c "npm …"`, **või**
- Sea Cursori / VS Code **Default Profile** terminaliks **Command Prompt** (`cmd`) või **Git Bash**, mitte PowerShell.

Kokkuvõte

## Muudetud failid

1. **`lib/auth.ts`**
   - Lisatud **Credentials** provider (e‑post + parool).
   - `authorize`: võrdleb `TEST_USER_EMAIL` ja `TEST_USER_PASSWORD` (kui puuduvad, siis devis `test@example.com` / `test123`); find-or-create `User` selle e‑posti järgi.
   - `session.strategy: 'jwt'` (Credentials nõuab JWT, OAuth/Email kasutavad endiselt adapterit User/Account jaoks).

2. **`app/login/page.tsx`**
   - E‑posti ja parooli vorm esimesena, nupp **«Sisselogi»**.
   - Veateade: «Vale e‑post või parool.» (kui `signIn('credentials')` tagastab vea).
   - **Arendusrežiimis** kollane kast: **«Testikasutaja: test@example.com / test123»**.
   - All: jagaja, siis magic link ja Google/Apple.

3. **`app/[locale]/login/page.tsx`**
   - Sama loogika; kasutab `t('auth.*')` seal, kus võimalik; uued sõnad (Parool, Sisselogi, viga, Testikasutaja) eesti keeles.

---

## Kuidas testida

1. **`npm run dev`** (või taustal jooksev dev server).
2. Mine **`/login`** või **`/et/login`** (või teine `[locale]`).
3. Arendusrežiimis peaks näha kasti: **«Testikasutaja: test@example.com / test123»**.
4. Sisesta `test@example.com` ja `test123`, vajuta **«Sisselogi»** → suunatakse `/app`.
5. Vale parool/e‑post → **«Vale e‑post või parool.»**.

---

## Keskkonna muutujad (valikuline)

`.env` või `.env.local`:

```env
# Testkasutaja (valikuline; devi vaike: test@example.com / test123)
TEST_USER_EMAIL=test@example.com
TEST_USER_PASSWORD=test123
```

Kui need puuduvad, kasutatakse **ainult devis** vaikimisi `test@example.com` / `test123`. Tootes Credentials sisselogimine ei tööta, kui `TEST_USER_EMAIL` ja `TEST_USER_PASSWORD` pole seatud.

---

## Turvalisus

- Parooli ei salvestata; võrreldakse `TEST_USER_PASSWORD` või devi vaike.
- Testikasutaja kast on ainult `NODE_ENV === 'development'` korral.
- **Tootes** Credentials töötab vaid siis, kui mõlemad `TEST_*` on .env-is seatud; soovitav tugev parool.

---

Sisselogimisleht peaks nüüd brauseris olema.

**Dev-server** jookseb juba **http://localhost:3002** (pordid 3000 ja 3001 olid hõivatud).

**Avatud leht:** http://localhost:3002/login  

Sealt näed:
- vormi **E‑post** ja **Parool**
- nuppu **«Sisselogi»**
- arendusrežiimis kasti **«Testikasutaja: test@example.com / test123»**
- all magic linki ja Google/Apple võimalused

Kui andmebaas ei ole ühendatud, võib **test@example.com** / **test123** puhul tulla viga (Credentials provider proovib leida/luua kasutajat). Kui `DATABASE_URL` viitab Neonile ja see on kättesaamatus, siis sisselogimine ebaõnnestub.

---


Jah, **backend on valmis**.

| Osa | Fail | Roll |
|-----|------|------|
| **Auth API** | `app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts` | NextAuth handler – kõik `/api/auth/*` (signin, callback/credentials jne) |
| **Credentials + autoriseerimine** | `lib/auth.ts` | Credentials provider, `authorize` (parooli võrdlus, `findUnique` / `create` User), JWT session, `session` + `jwt` callbackid |

Kui vajutad «Sisselogi»:
1. Päring läheb `/api/auth/callback/credentials` (POST)
2. `authorize` võrdleb `test@example.com` / `test123` (või `TEST_USER_*` .env-ist)
3. Kasutaja leitakse või luuakse (`prisma.user`)
4. Tagastatakse `{ id, email, name }` → JWT küpsesse → `session.user.id` jms

**Sõltuvus:** see töötab ainult siis, kui **andmebaas on kättesaadav**. Kui `DATABASE_URL` viitab Neonile ja server ei ole võrgust kättesaadav, siis `prisma.user.findUnique` / `create` annab vea ja sisselogimine ebaõnnestub.

**Kokkuvõte:** backend (API + `authorize` + JWT) on valmis; töökindel sisselogimine eeldab töötavat andmebaasi.

Kokkuvõte, mida on tehtud ja mida teha:

---

## Tehtud

1. **`.env.local`** (loodud PowerShelli kaudu)  
   - `DATABASE_URL="postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db"`  
   - `AUTH_SECRET="voucher-dev-secret-min-32-chars-long"`

2. **Docker Postgres**  
   - `voucher-postgres` jookseb; andmebaas `voucher_db` on kasutusel.

3. **`prisma db push`**  
   - Skeem on lokaalse andmebaasiga sünkroonis.

4. **`prisma/ensure-test-user.ts`** ja `npm run db:ensure-test-user`  
   - Tagab: `coffee-house` (merchant), kasutaja `test@example.com`, liikmelisus `merchant_admin`.  
   - Töötab ka siis, kui `db:seed` on juba korra käivitatud ja annab viga.

5. **`prisma/seed.ts`**  
   - Lisatud `test@example.com` ja tema `MerchantMember` (uute installide jaoks).

---

## Sinu poolt vajalik: taaskäivita dev-server

Praegune `npm run dev` laeb endiselt vana `.env` (nt Neon).  
Uue `.env.local` laadimiseks:

1. Peata praegune `npm run dev` (nt **Ctrl+C**).
2. Käivita uuesti:  
   `npm run dev`

Pärast seda kasutab rakendus lokaalset Postgresit ja `AUTH_SECRET`-i `.env.local`-ist.

---

## Kuidas proovida

1. `http://localhost:3000/login` (või 3001/3002, olenevalt pordist).
2. **test@example.com** / **test123** → „Sisselogi”.
3. Suunatakse `/app`; näed kaarti **Coffee House** (Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard).

---

## Kui tahad `db:seed` uuesti käivitada (nt puhas andmebaas)

Käsud endiselt **lokaalse** andmebaasiga (Prisma loeb vaikimisi `.env`-ist, mitte `.env.local`-ist):

```powershell
$env:DATABASE_URL = "postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db"
npm run db:seed
```

Kui `db:seed` annab viga (nt `slug` juba olemas), kasuta:

```powershell
$env:DATABASE_URL = "postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db"
npm run db:ensure-test-user
```

---

**Kokkuvätte:** Taaskäivita `npm run dev`, siis sisselogimine `test@example.com` / `test123` ja `/app` (sh Coffee House) peaks töötama.

Kokkuvõte: **täiskäivitus ühe käsuga**

---

## `npm run dev:full`

Üks käsk teeb kõik vajaliku:

1. **Docker** – kontrollib, et Docker töötab  
2. **`.env.local`** – `DATABASE_URL` (lokaalne Postgres) ja `AUTH_SECRET`  
3. **Postgres** – `docker compose up -d postgres`  
4. **Ootamine** – `wait-for-db.ps1` kuni andmebaas on valmis  
5. **Prisma** – `prisma db push`  
6. **Andmed** – `db:seed` (võib kukku, kui andmed juba olemas)  
7. **Testkasutaja** – `db:ensure-test-user` (test@example.com + Coffee House)  
8. **Dev-server** – `npm run dev`

---

## Kuidas käivitada

```bash
npm install
npm run dev:full
```

Eeldus: **Docker Desktop** on käivitatud.

---

## Testimiseks

| Mis | Kuidas |
|-----|--------|
| **Sisselogimine** | http://localhost:3000/login → `test@example.com` / `test123` |
| **App (Wallet, Vouchers)** | /app → Coffee House |
| **Merchant dashboard** | /merchant/coffee-house/dashboard |
| **Voucher, jagamine, redeem** | QUICKSTART.md → "Test the Flow" |

---

## Muudetud/loodud failid

- **`scripts/dev-full.ps1`** – täiskäivituskiript
- **`package.json`** – skript `dev:full`
- **`QUICKSTART.md`** – juhend `dev:full` ja test@example.com kohta

`db:push` ajal võib Prisma generaator anda **EPERM** (fail lukus); `db push` ise käib läbi. Kui näed viga, proovi enne `npm run dev:full` sulgeda teised Node/IDE protsessid või taaskäivita terminal.

---

Replacing `Test-NetConnection` in `wait-for-db.ps1` with a quiet `TcpClient`-based check so only "Waiting for PostgreSQL..." and "✅ Database is ready!" (or the final error) are printed.

Plan:
- File: `scripts/wait-for-db.ps1`
- Change: Use `System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient` to connect to `127.0.0.1:5432` in a try/catch instead of `Test-NetConnection`. Keep existing "Waiting...", "Still waiting...", and final error messages.
- Why: `Test-NetConnection` writes to the information stream ("Attempting TCP connect", "Waiting for response"); `TcpClient` is silent.


---

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="edit_file_v2">

<details><summary>Tool use: **edit_file_v2** • Edit file: c:\Users\tahk8\voucher\scripts\wait-for-db.ps1</summary>

</details>

</tool-use>

---

**Summary**

- **File changed:** `scripts/wait-for-db.ps1`
- **Change:** `Test-NetConnection` was replaced with `System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient` connecting to `127.0.0.1:5432`. Only your `Write-Host` messages are printed; no extra PowerShell output.
- **Reason:** `Test-NetConnection` writes to the information stream (“Attempting TCP connect”, “Waiting for response”); `TcpClient` does not.

**How to test**

1. Stop any running `dev:full` / `next dev` (and free 3000–3004 if needed: `npx kill-port 3000 3001 3002 3003 3004` or close the extra terminals).
2. Run: `npm run dev:full`
3. During “Waiting for DB…” you should only see:  
   `Waiting for PostgreSQL database to be ready...` and then `✅ Database is ready!` (and, if it retries, `Still waiting...`). No `Test-NetConnection` or “Attempting TCP connect” lines.

**Port 3000–3004 in use**

That usually means several `dev:full` or `next dev` runs. Use a single `dev:full` and, if needed, free the ports or close the extra dev terminals.

**Summary**

- **File:** `app/global-error.tsx`
- **Change:** Replaced all `style={{}}` with a `<style>` block in `<head>` and classes (`.ge-root`, `.ge-h1`, `.ge-p`, `.ge-btn`). `ge-` is a short namespace so these don’t clash with other CSS.
- **Reason:** The `no-inline-styles` rule targets the `style` attribute; using a `<style>` and `className` avoids that. Styles stay in the component because `global-error` replaces the root layout and can’t rely on `globals.css` or Tailwind.

**How to check**

1. Open `app/global-error.tsx` — the `no-inline-styles` hints should be gone.
2. Trigger a global error (e.g. `throw new Error('test')` in `app/layout.tsx`), run the app, and confirm the error page layout and “Try again” button look and work the same.

        "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise staatus\n\n## ✅ Valmis\n\n1. **i18n konfiguratsioon**\n   - ✅ 5 keelt: en, et, es, fr, de\n   - ✅ Routing konfiguratsioon\n   - ✅ Middleware locale detection'iga\n\n2. **Tõlked**\n   - ✅ Inglise (en) - täielik\n   - ✅ Eesti (et) - täielik\n   - ✅ Hispaania (es) - täielik\n   - ✅ Prantsuse (fr) - täielik\n   - ✅ Saksa (de) - täielik\n\n3. **Komponendid**\n   - ✅ Language selector\n   - ✅ Locale-aware layout\n   - ✅ i18n utilities (valuuta, kuupäevad)\n\n4. **Dokumentatsioon**\n   - ✅ I18N_GUIDE.md - täielik juhend\n\n## ⚠️ Vajab täiendamist\n\n### 1. Olemasolevate lehtede migreerimine\n\nPraegu on palju lehti, mis ei kasuta tõlkeid. Need tuleb järk-järgult migreerida:\n\n**Prioriteet 1 (kõrge):**\n- &#96;app/login/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/app/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n\n**Prioriteet 2 (keskmine):**\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/dashboard/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet/page.tsx&#96;\n\n**Prioriteet 3 (madal):**\n- Kõik ülejäänud lehed\n\n### 2.         "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cp .env.example .env\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n   Edit &#96;.env&#96; and configure:",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; - Public merchant page (should be removed per spec)\n\n### UI Look &amp; Feel\n- ✅ Premium, calm, confident design\n- ✅ Mobile-first responsive\n- ✅ One primary CTA per screen\n- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s",

        "contents": "Ei mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena\n\nKui UI on ilus, aga aeglane → vale.\n\n## 8) PWA REEGLID\n\nInstallitav\n\nNative share (mobile)\n\nOffline QR juba avatud voucheritele\n\niOS &amp; Android browser support\n\n## 9) LOGGING &amp; AUDIT\n\nKõik admin/staff tegevused → AuditLog\n\nÄra logi tundlikke andmeid\n\nRiskisündmused märgista (fraud flags)\n\n## 10) DONE DEFINITSIOON (ABSOLUUTNE)\n\nMVP on DONE, kui lokaalselt seed’iga:\n\nAvan voucheri\n\nLoon referral’i\n\nJagan linki\n\nFriend redeem’ib\n\nStaff kinnitab\n\nCredit tekib locked\n\nCredit unlock’itakse\n\nCredit kasutatakse demo checkout’is\n\nKui üks samm ei tööta → NOT DONE.\n\n## 11) KEEELUD (AUTOMAATNE STOPP)\n\nCursor EI TOHI:\n\nlisada uusi lehti\n\nlisada uusi rolle\n\nlisada uusi tasemeid\n\nlisada analytics’e “niisama”\n\n“parandada UX-i” scope’i laiendades\n\nKui tekib kiusatus → kirjuta V2 backlog’isse, ära ehita.\n\n## 12) BUILD ORDER (JÄRGI)\n\nPrisma schema + migrations\n\nAuth + RBAC + tenancy\n\nPublic voucher &amp; referral pages\n\nMerchant voucher builder\n\nRedemption + credit pipeline\n\nWallet UI\n\nPWA polish\n\nTests + seed + docs\n\n## 13) SUHTLUSREEGEL\n\nKui midagi on ebaselge → küsi\n\nKui miski ei mahu MVP-sse → ära tee\n\nKui reegel on vastuolus ideega → idee kaotab\n\n## 14) FILOSOOFIA\n\nSee projekt ei võida müraga.\nSee võidab selguse, distsipliini ja usaldusega.\n\nBuild infrastructure.\nNot hype.",

        "contents": "# Changelog\n\n## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX\n\n### Added\n- Multi-tenant voucher platform with merchant isolation\n- Voucher creation, publishing, and management\n- Referral system with shareable links\n- Credit system (locked/unlocked states)\n- Weekly drop functionality with stock management\n- PWA support with service worker and offline QR codes\n- RBAC (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- Fraud prevention (rate limiting, self-referral prevention)\n- Email magic link authentication\n- Google and Apple OAuth support\n- Merchant dashboard\n- User wallet and credit management\n- Checkout demo for credit application\n- API documentation\n- Unit tests for credit system\n- Seed data script\n- Docker compose setup for local development\n\n### Technical\n- Next.js 14 with App Router\n- TypeScript strict mode\n- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL\n- TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui components\n- NextAuth for authentication\n- Zod for validation\n- Vitest for testing\n- i18n structure (next-intl, ready for expansion)\n\n## [1.1.0] - 2024-01-XX (Planned)\n\n### Added\n- Voucher publish endpoint\n- Voucher update endpoint\n- Better error handling with custom error classes\n- Type definitions\n- Session provider for client components\n- Validation utilities\n\n### Fixed\n- Missing publish functionality\n- TypeScript type safety improvements",

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",

          },
          {
            "text": "## Manual Onboarding Flow",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "## Kill Switch",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "To disable a merchant:",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "UPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "This should:",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- Hide merchant from public routes",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- Prevent new voucher creation",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- Allow existing redemptions to complete",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- Log action in AuditLog",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "## No Public Signup",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ No public merchant signup form",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",
            "lineNumber": 69
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.23335300385951996

        "contents": "├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n\n### Referrals\n\n- &#96;POST /api/referrals/create&#96; - Create referral and get share URL\n\n### Redemptions\n\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions&#96; - Create redemption\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&#96; - Confirm redemption (staff)\n\n### Credits\n\n- &#96;GET /api/wallet/[merchantSlug]&#96; - Get credit balance\n- &#96;POST /api/credits/apply&#96; - Apply credit to order\n\n### Weekly Drop\n\n- &#96;POST /api/weekly-drop/claim&#96; - Claim weekly drop stock\n\n## Database Schema\n\nKey models:\n\n- &#96;Merchant&#96;: Tenant information\n- &#96;User&#96;: Platform users\n- &#96;MerchantMember&#96;: User-merchant relationships with roles\n- &#96;Voucher&#96;: Voucher definitions\n- &#96;Referral&#96;: Referral instances",
        "signatures": {},

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

**Kokkuvõte**

- **Fail:** `templates/emails/voucher-purchase-receipt.tsx`
- **Muudatus:** Asendatud kõik `style={{}}` atribuudid `<style>` blokiga ja CSS klassidega (`.vpr-container`, `.vpr-h1`, `.vpr-box`, jne). `vpr-` on nimeruum, et vältida konflikte.
- **Miks:** `no-inline-styles` reegel nõuab, et stiilid oleksid `<style>` blokis või välises CSS-is, mitte inline atribuutides.

**Kinnitamine**

Kõik `no-inline-styles` vead on parandatud. Fail vastab nüüd reeglitele.

**Märkus:** Paljud e-posti kliendid ei toeta `<style>` blokke. Kui kasutad React Email või sarnast teeki, mis inline-istab stiilid renderimise ajal, peaks see töötama. Kui mitte, võib olla vaja tagasi inline-stiilide juurde või kasutada HTML-i renderimiseks inline-stiilidega teeki.

Kõik kolm email template'i (`credit-earned.tsx`, `voucher-delivery.tsx`, `voucher-purchase-receipt.tsx`) on nüüd parandatud ja järgivad sama stiilimustrit.

        "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96;         "contents": "Ei mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena\n\nKui UI on ilus, aga aeglane → vale.\n\n## 8) PWA REEGLID\n\nInstallitav\n\nNative share (mobile)\n\nOffline QR juba avatud voucheritele\n\niOS &amp; Android browser support\n\n## 9) LOGGING &amp; AUDIT\n\nKõik admin/staff tegevused → AuditLog\n\nÄra logi tundlikke andmeid\n\nRiskisündmused märgista (fraud flags)\n\n## 10) DONE DEFINITSIOON (ABSOLUUTNE)\n\nMVP on DONE, kui lokaalselt seed’iga:\n\nAvan voucheri\n\nLoon referral’i\n\nJagan linki\n\nFriend redeem’ib\n\nStaff kinnitab\n\nCredit tekib locked\n\nCredit unlock’itakse\n\nCredit kasutatakse demo checkout’is\n\nKui üks samm ei tööta → NOT DONE.\n\n## 11) KEEELUD (AUTOMAATNE STOPP)\n\nCursor EI TOHI:\n\nlisada uusi lehti\n\nlisada uusi rolle\n\nlisada uusi tasemeid\n\nlisada analytics’e “niisama”\n\n“parandada UX-i” scope’i laiendades\n\nKui tekib kiusatus → kirjuta V2 backlog’isse, ära ehita.\n\n## 12) BUILD ORDER (JÄRGI)\n\nPrisma schema + migrations\n\nAuth + RBAC + tenancy\n\nPublic voucher &amp; referral pages\n\nMerchant voucher builder\n\nRedemption + credit pipeline\n\nWallet UI\n\nPWA polish\n\nTests + seed + docs\n\n## 13) SUHTLUSREEGEL\n\nKui midagi on ebaselge → küsi\n\nKui miski ei mahu MVP-sse → ära tee\n\nKui reegel on vastuolus ideega → idee kaotab\n\n## 14) FILOSOOFIA\n\nSee projekt ei võida müraga.\nSee võidab selguse, distsipliini ja usaldusega.\n\nBuild infrastructure.\nNot hype.",

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cp .env.example .env\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n   Edit &#96;.env&#96; and configure:",

        "contents": "## 🎯 Prioriteet 4: UX Täiustused\n\n### 13. Better Mobile UX ⭐⭐\n- Bottom navigation\n- Swipe gestures\n- Pull to refresh\n- Mobile-optimized forms\n\n### 14. Real-time Updates ⭐\n- WebSocket või polling\n- Live redemption updates\n- Real-time credit balance\n- Notification badges\n\n### 15. Accessibility ⭐\n- ARIA labels\n- Keyboard navigation\n- Screen reader support\n- High contrast mode\n\n## 🎯 Prioriteet 5: Security &amp; Performance\n\n### 16. Advanced Security ⭐⭐\n- 2FA support\n- IP whitelisting\n- Session management\n- Audit log viewer\n\n### 17.         "contents": "# Changelog\n\n## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX\n\n### Added\n- Multi-tenant voucher platform with merchant isolation\n- Voucher creation, publishing, and management\n- Referral system with shareable links\n- Credit system (locked/unlocked states)\n- Weekly drop functionality with stock management\n- PWA support with service worker and offline QR codes\n- RBAC (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- Fraud prevention (rate limiting, self-referral prevention)\n- Email magic link authentication\n- Google and Apple OAuth support\n- Merchant dashboard\n- User wallet and credit management\n- Checkout demo for credit application\n- API documentation\n- Unit tests for credit system\n- Seed data script\n- Docker compose setup for local development\n\n### Technical\n- Next.js 14 with App Router\n- TypeScript strict mode\n- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL\n- TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui components\n- NextAuth for authentication\n- Zod for validation\n- Vitest for testing\n- i18n structure (next-intl, ready for expansion)\n\n## [1.1.0] - 2024-01-XX (Planned)\n\n### Added\n- Voucher publish endpoint\n- Voucher update endpoint\n- Better error handling with custom error classes\n- Type definitions\n- Session provider for client components\n- Validation utilities\n\n### Fixed\n- Missing publish functionality\n- TypeScript type safety improvements",

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",

            "text": "  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "### Feature Flag Examples",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "## Manual Onboarding Flow",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "## Kill Switch",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "To disable a merchant:",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "UPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "This should:",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- Hide merchant from public routes",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- Prevent new voucher creation",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- Allow existing redemptions to complete",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- Log action in AuditLog",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "## No Public Signup",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ No public merchant signup form",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",
            "lineNumber": 69
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

        "contents": "# Testing Guide - MVP Done Definition\n\nThis guide walks through all 8 steps of the MVP \"done definition\" to verify the platform works end-to-end.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Database is seeded: &#96;npm run db:seed&#96;\n2. Development server is running: &#96;npm run dev&#96;\n3. You have two browser windows/tabs (one for referrer, one for friend)\n\n## Test Data\n\nAfter seeding, you should have:\n- **Merchant**: Coffee House (slug: &#96;coffee-house&#96;)\n- **Admin user**: &#96;admin@coffee-house.com&#96;\n- **Regular user**: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n- **Vouchers**: At least one published voucher\n\n## Step-by-Step Test Flow\n\n### Step 1: Open Voucher Page ✅\n\n1. **Find a voucher ID** from the database:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n   SELECT id, \"codePrefix\" FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Open voucher page**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Should load without login\n   - Should show merchant branding\n   - Should display voucher value clearly\n   - Should have \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" button (if logged in)\n\n**Expected**: Voucher page loads in &lt;3 seconds, shows value, merchant brand visible.\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Create Referral ✅\n\n1. **Login as user**:\n   - Go to &#96;http://localhost:3000/login&#96;\n   - Use email: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n   - Check email for magic link (or use OAuth if configured)\n\n2. **Open voucher page** (from Step 1)\n\n3. **Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"**:\n   - Should create referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n   - Should generate share URL: &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n   - Should show native share sheet or copy link\n\n**Expected**: Referral created, share URL generated, link can be copied/shared.\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Share Link ✅\n\n1. **Copy the referral link** from Step 2\n   - Format: &#96;http://localhost:3000/r/[referralId]&#96;\n\n2. **Verify link is shareable**:\n   - Can be copied to clipboard\n   - Native share works (if on mobile/PWA)\n\n**Expected**: Link is valid and shareable.\n\n---\n\n### Step 4: Friend Redeems Voucher ✅\n\n1. **Open referral link in incognito/private window**:\n   ",

        "contents": "├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n\n### Referrals\n\n- &#96;POST /api/referrals/create&#96; - Create referral and get share URL\n\n### Redemptions\n\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions&#96; - Create redemption\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&#96; - Confirm redemption (staff)\n\n### Credits\n\n- &#96;GET /api/wallet/[merchantSlug]&#96; - Get credit balance\n- &#96;POST /api/credits/apply&#96; - Apply credit to order\n\n### Weekly Drop\n\n- &#96;POST /api/weekly-drop/claim&#96; - Claim weekly drop stock\n\n## Database Schema\n\nKey models:\n\n- &#96;Merchant&#96;: Tenant information\n- &#96;User&#96;: Platform users\n- &#96;MerchantMember&#96;: User-merchant relationships with roles\n- &#96;Voucher&#96;: Voucher definitions\n- &#96;Referral&#96;: Referral instances",

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Implementation Guide\n\nThis guide explains how to use the launch mode features (kill switch and feature flags) that have been prepared for the platform.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Run the migration to add launch mode fields:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma migrate dev --name launch_mode\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nOr manually apply the SQL from &#96;prisma/migrations/launch_mode/migration.sql&#96;\n\n2. Regenerate Prisma client:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma generate\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Kill Switch\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;isActive&#96; field on the &#96;Merchant&#96; model acts as a kill switch. When set to &#96;false&#96;:\n- Merchant is hidden from public routes\n- New voucher creation is blocked\n- Existing redemptions can complete\n- All actions are logged to AuditLog\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Deactivate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { deactivateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Deactivate merchant (requires platform admin)\nawait deactivateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId, 'Reason for deactivation');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Activate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { activateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Activate merchant\nawait activateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Check Merchant Status in API Routes\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  // ... auth checks ...\n  \n  // Check merchant is active\n  await requireActiveMerchant(merchant.id);\n  \n  // Continue with voucher creation...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### SQL Direct Access\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Deactivate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Activate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = true WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Check status\nSELECT id, name, \"isActive\" FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Feature Flags\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;featureFlags&#96; JSON field on &#96;Merchant&#96; stores per-merchant feature flags. This allows enabling/disabling features per merchant without code changes.\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Check Feature Flag\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

          },

          {
            "text": "## Prerequisites",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Run the migration to add launch mode fields:",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "npx prisma migrate dev --name launch_mode",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "Or manually apply the SQL from &#96;prisma/migrations/launch_mode/migration.sql&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Regenerate Prisma client:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "npx prisma generate",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## Kill Switch",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "### How It Works",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "The &#96;isActive&#96; field on the &#96;Merchant&#96; model acts as a kill switch. When set to &#96;false&#96;:",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- Merchant is hidden from public routes",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- New voucher creation is blocked",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- Existing redemptions can complete",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- All actions are logged to AuditLog",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "### Usage",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Deactivate a Merchant",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "import { deactivateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "// Deactivate merchant (requires platform admin)",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "await deactivateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId, 'Reason for deactivation');",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Activate a Merchant",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "import { activateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "// Activate merchant",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "await activateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId);",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Check Merchant Status in API Routes",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "import { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "  // ... auth checks ...",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "  // Check merchant is active",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "  await requireActiveMerchant(merchant.id);",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "  // Continue with voucher creation...",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "#### SQL Direct Access",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Deactivate merchant",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "UPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Activate merchant",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "UPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = true WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Check status",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "SELECT id, name, \"isActive\" FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "## Feature Flags",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "### How It Works",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "The &#96;featureFlags&#96; JSON field on &#96;Merchant&#96; stores per-merchant feature flags. This allows enabling/disabling features per merchant without code changes.",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "### Usage",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Check Feature Flag",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 87
          }
        ]
      },

    }
  ]
}

        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n\n}\n\nexport default async function VoucherPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: { merchant: true },\n  });\n\n  if (!voucher || voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = voucher.designJson\n    ?         "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check validity dates\n    const now = new Date();\n    if (now &lt; voucher.validFrom || now &gt; voucher.validTo) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher expired or not yet valid' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check usage limits\n    if (voucher.usageLimitTotal) {\n      const totalRedemptions = await prisma.redemption.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          confirmedAt: { not: null },\n        },\n      });\n      if (totalRedemptions &gt;= voucher.usageLimitTotal) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher usage limit reached' }, { status: 400 });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // If referral exists, check self-referral and rate limits\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "export async function applyCredit(\n  userId: string,\n  merchantId: string,\n  amount: number,\n  orderReference: string\n): Promise&lt;{ success: boolean; creditIds: string[] }&gt; {\n\n\n  // Use transaction to atomically update credits and create usage record\n  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n    // Mark credits as used (or partially used)\n    for (const { id, amount: useAmount } of creditsToUse) {\n      const credit = await tx.creditLedger.findUnique({\n        where: { id },\n      });\n\n      if (!credit) continue;\n\n      if (useAmount === credit.amount) {\n        // Fully used\n        await tx.creditLedger.update({\n          where: { id },\n          data: { status: 'used' },\n        });\n      } else {\n        // Partially used - create new ledger entry for remaining\n        await tx.creditLedger.update({\n          where: { id },\n          data: { status: 'used' },\n        });\n        await tx.creditLedger.create({\n          data: {\n            merchantId,\n            userId,\n            amount: credit.amount - useAmount,\n            currency: credit.currency,\n            status: 'available',\n            source: credit.source,\n            sourceId: credit.sourceId,\n            expiresAt: credit.expiresAt,\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Create usage record\n    await tx.creditUsage.create({\n      data: {\n        merchantId,\n        userId,\n        creditLedgerIds: creditIds,\n        amountUsed: amount,\n        orderReference,\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  return { success: true, creditIds };\n}",
