    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 125
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 202
          }
        },
        "contents": "├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3.         "contents": "  @@unique([merchantId, userId])\n  @@index([merchantId])\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel Campaign {\n  id              String   @id @default(cuid())\n  merchantId      String\n  name            String\n  description     String?\n  type            String   // weekly | limited\n  startDate       DateTime\n  endDate         DateTime\n  price           Int?     // minor units, null = free\n  discountRules   Json?    // { type, value, currency }\n  maxRedemptions  Int?\n  maxPurchases    Int?\n  terms           String?\n  creditPercentage Int?    // % of purchase price as credit (basis points, e.g. 500 = 5%)\n  status          String   @default(\"draft\") // draft | active | ended\n  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt\n\n  merchant Merchant @relation(fields: [merchantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  vouchers Voucher[]\n  purchases VoucherPurchase[]\n\n  @@index([merchantId])\n  @@index([status])\n  @@index([startDate, endDate])\n}\n\nmodel Voucher {\n  id                String   @id @default(cuid())\n  merchantId        String\n  campaignId        String?\n  status            String   @default(\"draft\") // draft | published | paused | ended\n  type              String   // percentage | fixed_amount | credit_amount\n  value             Int      // minor units for money, basis points for percentage\n  currency          String\n  validFrom         DateTime\n  validTo           DateTime\n  usageLimitTotal   Int?\n  usageLimitPerUser Int?\n  weeklyDropEnabled Boolean  @default(false)\n  weeklyDropJson    Json?\n  conditionsJson    Json?\n  designJson        Json?\n  codePrefix        String?\n  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt",

        "contents": "export default function VoucherClient({\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isAuthenticated,\n}: VoucherClientProps) {\n  const [isSharing, setIsSharing] = useState(false);\n  const [got, setGot] = useState(false);\n\n  const brandBg = brandColors?.background || design?.backgroundColor || '#fafafa';\n  const brandPrimary = brandColors?.primary || design?.primaryColor || '#18181b';\n\n  const handleGet = async () =&gt; {\n    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(voucherCode);\n    showSuccess('Voucher code copied');\n    setGot(true);\n    setTimeout(() =&gt; setGot(false), 1500);\n  };\n\n  const handleShare = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsSharing(true);\n    let url = window.location.href;\n    if (isAuthenticated) {\n      try {\n        const res = await fetch('/api/referrals/create', {\n          method: 'POST',\n          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n          body: JSON.stringify({ voucherId: voucher.id }),\n        });\n        const data = await res.json();\n        if (data.shareUrl) url = data.shareUrl;\n      } catch {\n        // use /v/ link as fallback\n      }\n    }\n    if (navigator.share) {\n      try {\n        await navigator.share({\n          title: design?.headline || 'Special Offer',\n          text: &#96;Check out this voucher from ${voucher.merchant.name}&#96;,\n          url,\n        });\n        showSuccess('Link shared');\n      } catch {\n        // cancelled or error\n      }\n    } else {\n      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);\n      showInfo('Link copied to clipboard');\n    }\n    setIsSharing(false);\n  };\n\n  const getVoucherValue = () =&gt; {\n    if (voucher.type === 'percentage') return formatPercentage(voucher.value);\n    return formatCurrency(voucher.value, voucher.currency);\n  };\n\n  const headline = design?.headline || 'Special Offer';\n  const limitText = voucher.usageLimitTotal\n    ? &#96; · First ${voucher.usageLimitTotal} uses&#96;\n    : '';\n\n  const scope = &#96;voucher-theme-${String(voucher.id).replace(/\\s/g, '')}&#96;;\n}",

        "contents": "# Vouchr — Full Audit\n\n**Date:** 2025-01  \n**Scope:** Get project running; deps, scripts, auth, env, routes.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Package &amp; Scripts ✅\n\n| Script | Action |\n| --- | --- |\n| &#96;dev&#96; | next dev |\n| &#96;dev:full&#96; | scripts/dev-full.ps1: .env.local, Docker Postgres, db push, seed, ensure-test-user, dev |\n| &#96;db:setup&#96; | db:check, docker:up, wait 5s, db:wait, db:push, db:seed (no ensure-test-user) |\n| &#96;db:seed&#96; | tsx prisma/seed.ts |\n| &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96; | tsx prisma/ensure-test-user.ts ([test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) + Coffee House) |\n| &#96;db:push&#96; | prisma db push |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; is the one-command path; requires Docker Desktop.\n- &#96;db:setup&#96; does not run &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96;; seed already upserts &#96;test@example.com&#96; and member.\n- **Seed on existing DB:** &#96;merchant.create&#96; etc. can fail with \"Unique constraint\" (e.g. &#96;slug&#96;). Run &#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96;; test user and Coffee House are then ensured.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Auth ✅\n\n- **Credentials:** [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) / test123 (dev; from &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96;, &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; or defaults).\n- **Email:** magic link (needs SMTP in .env).\n- **OAuth:** Google, Apple (optional env).\n- **Session:** &#96;strategy: 'jwt'&#96; (required for Credentials).\n\n---\n\n## 3. Env\n\n| Var | Required | Notes |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; | yes | Local: &#96;postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db&#96; |\n| &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; | yes | min 32 chars |\n| &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; | optional | e.g. &lt;http://localhost:3000&gt; |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96; | no | default [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) (dev) |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; | no | default test123 (dev) |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; overwrites &#96;.env.local&#96; with &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; and &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96;.\n- &#96;.env&#96; is used when &#96;.env.local&#96; is absent; ensure only one &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; (local Postgres).\n\n---\n\n## 4. Login &amp; /app ✅\n\n- **/login:** Credentials (e‑post+parool), magic link, Google, Apple. Test hint shown in dev.\n- **/app:** After login, lists user’s merchants (Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard). [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) is &#96;merchant_admin&#96; for Coffee House (seed + ensure-test-user).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Docker &amp; DB ✅\n\n- **docker-compose.yml:** postgres (voucher_user, voucher_pass, voucher_db, 5432), redis.",

        "contents": "# Deployment Checklist\n\nUse this checklist before deploying to production.\n\n## Pre-Deployment\n\n### Environment Variables\n- [ ] &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; - Production PostgreSQL connection string\n- [ ] &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; - Random 32+ character string\n- [ ] &#96;NEXTAUTH_SECRET&#96; - Random 32+ character string\n- [ ] &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL&#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_HOST&#96; - Email server for magic links\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_PORT&#96; - Email server port\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_USER&#96; - Email server username\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_PASSWORD&#96; - Email server password\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_FROM&#96; - From email address\n- [ ] &#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID&#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET&#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_CLIENT_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_CLIENT_SECRET&#96; - Apple OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96; - Comma-separated admin emails\n- [ ] &#96;REDIS_URL&#96; - Redis connection (optional, for rate limiting)\n\n### Database\n- [ ] Production database created\n- [ ] Migration run: &#96;npx prisma migrate deploy&#96;\n- [ ] Prisma client generated: &#96;npx prisma generate&#96;\n- [ ] Seed data loaded (if needed)\n- [ ] Database backups configured\n\n### Security\n- [ ] All secrets in environment variables (not in code)\n- [ ] HTTPS enabled\n- [ ] CORS configured correctly\n- [ ] Rate limiting configured\n- [ ] CSRF protection enabled (Next.js default)\n\n### PWA\n- [ ] &#96;manifest.json&#96; updated with production URL\n- [ ] Icons generated (192x192, 512x512)\n- [ ] Service worker tested\n- [ ] Offline functionality tested\n\n## Deployment Steps\n\n### 1. Build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Test Build Locally\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm start\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Deploy\n- Deploy to your hosting platform (Vercel, Render, etc.)\n- Set all environment variables\n- Run database migrations\n\n### 4. Post-Deployment\n\n#### Verify\n- [ ] Homepage loads\n- [ ] Login works\n- [ ] Magic link emails sent\n- [ ] OAuth providers work (if configured)\n- [ ] Voucher pages load\n- [ ] Referral pages load\n- [ ] PWA installable",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\redemptions\\[id]\\confirm\\route.ts",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "column": 56
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 50,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { unlockCreditForRedemption } from '@/lib/credits';\n\nexport async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { id: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const redemption = await prisma.redemption.findUnique({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!redemption) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Redemption not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (redemption.confirmedAt) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Redemption already confirmed' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Require merchant staff or admin role\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, redemption.merchantId, 'merchant_staff');\n\n    // Confirm redemption\n    await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      await tx.redemption.update({\n        where: { id: params.id },\n        data: { confirmedAt: new Date(), redeemedByStaffUserId: session.user.id },\n      });\n\n      // Unlock credit if referral exists\n      if (redemption.referralId) {\n        await unlockCreditForRedemption(params.id, redemption.merchantId);\n      }\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error confirming redemption:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\vouchers\\[id]\\publish\\route.ts",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "column": 56
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 57,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { ensureMerchantOwnership } from '@/lib/tenant';\n\nexport async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { id: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, voucher.merchantId, 'merchant_admin');\n\n    // Validate voucher can be published\n    if (voucher.status === 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher already published' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    if (!voucher.designJson) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher design is required' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Update status to published\n    const updated = await prisma.voucher.update({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n      data: { status: 'published' },\n    });\n\n    // Log audit\n    await prisma.auditLog.create({\n      data: {\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        actorUserId: session.user.id,\n        action: 'voucher.published',\n        payloadJson: JSON.stringify({ voucherId: params.id }),\n      },\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json(updated);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error publishing voucher:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "# Ideed täiustamiseks\n\n## 🎯 Prioriteet 1: Praktilised täiustused\n\n### 1. Voucher Otsing &amp; Filtreerimine ⭐⭐⭐\n- Otsing välja (headline, code prefix)\n- Filtreerimine: status, type, date range\n- Sortimine: date, name, redemptions\n- Pagination suurtele listidele\n\n### 2. QR Code Download &amp; Print ⭐⭐⭐\n- QR code allalaadimine PNG-na\n- Print-friendly voucher view\n- Shareable image generation\n\n### 3. Referral Analytics ⭐⭐⭐\n- Kui palju jagatud\n- Kui palju avatud\n- Conversion rate (opened → redeemed)\n- Top referrers\n- Referral timeline\n\n### 4. Navigation &amp; Breadcrumbs ⭐⭐\n- Breadcrumb navigation\n- Mobile-friendly sidebar\n- Quick actions menu\n- User profile dropdown\n\n### 5. Export Funktsioonid ⭐⭐\n- Redemptions CSV export\n- Credits ledger export\n- Vouchers list export\n- Analytics reports\n\n## 🎯 Prioriteet 2: Email &amp; Notifications\n\n### 6. Email Notifications ⭐⭐⭐\n- Credit unlock notifications\n- Redemption confirmations\n- Weekly drop reminders\n- Credit expiry warnings (7 days, 1 day)\n- Welcome emails\n\n### 7. In-App Notifications ⭐⭐\n- Notification center\n- Unread count\n- Mark as read\n- Notification preferences\n\n## 🎯 Prioriteet 3: Advanced Features\n\n### 8. Voucher Mallid ⭐⭐\n- Eeldefineeritud mallid\n- Custom mallide salvestamine\n- Kiire voucher'ite loomine\n- Mallide jagamine merchant'ide vahel\n\n### 9. Voucher Scheduling ⭐⭐\n- Planeeritud avaldamine\n- Auto-pause/end\n- Recurring vouchers\n- Calendar view\n\n### 10. Advanced Analytics ⭐⭐\n- Time-series graafikud\n- Conversion funnels\n- Cohort analysis\n- Revenue attribution\n- A/B testing support\n\n### 11. Bulk Operations ⭐\n- Mitme voucher'i korraga avaldamine\n- Bulk status muutmine\n- CSV import vouchers\n- Bulk delete\n\n### 12. Voucher Kategooriad ⭐\n- Kategooriate süsteem\n- Filtreerimine kategooria järgi\n- Kategooriate haldus\n- Kategooriate statistika\n\n## 🎯 Prioriteet 4: UX Täiustused\n\n### 13. Better Mobile UX ⭐⭐\n- Bottom navigation\n- Swipe gestures\n- Pull to refresh",

        "contents": "3. **Create a voucher**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/vouchers/new&gt;\n   - Fill in the form and create a voucher\n\n4. **Share voucher**:\n   - View the voucher at &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" (requires login)\n   - Copy the referral link\n\n5. **Redeem voucher**:\n   - Open referral link in incognito/private window\n   - Enter order amount and click \"Redeem Online\"\n\n6. **Confirm redemption** (as staff):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/redemptions&gt;\n   - Click \"Confirm Redemption\" on pending redemptions\n\n7. **View credit wallet**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/app/coffee-house/wallet&gt;\n   - See unlocked credit\n\n8. **Apply credit**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/app/coffee-house/checkout-demo&gt;\n   - Enter order amount and apply credit\n\n## Seed Data\n\nThe seed script creates:\n\n- 2 merchants (Coffee House, Tech Store)\n- 3 users: [**test@example.com**](mailto:test@example.com) (parool: test123), [admin@coffee-house.com](mailto:admin@coffee-house.com), [user@example.com](mailto:user@example.com)\n- Sample vouchers, referrals, and credits\n\n&#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96; tagab [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) ja Coffee House liikmelisuse ka siis, kui seed on juba käivitatud.\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n**Docker Desktop not starting**:\n\n- Run: &#96;npm run db:check&#96; to check Docker status\n- Start Docker Desktop manually from Start Menu\n- See [TROUBLESHOOTING.md][troubleshooting] for detailed solutions\n\n**Database connection error**:\n\n- Run: &#96;npm run db:wait&#96; to wait for database\n- Check Docker containers: &#96;npm run docker:logs&#96;\n- Ensure Docker is running: &#96;docker ps&#96;\n- Restart: &#96;npm run docker:down &amp;&amp; npm run docker:up&#96;\n\n**Port already in use**:\n\n- Change port in &#96;package.json&#96;: &#96;\"dev\": \"next dev -p 3001\"&#96;\n\n**Auth not working**:\n\n- Ensure AUTH_SECRET and NEXTAUTH_SECRET are set in .env\n- For email magic links, configure SMTP settings\n- For OAuth, add provider credentials\n\n**PWA icons missing**:",

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "Kõik write’id:",

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "Ära salvesta:",

          },

          },
          {

          },

          {

        "contents": "# Deployment Guide\n\n## Pre-Deployment Checklist\n\n- [ ] All environment variables configured\n- [ ] Database migrations run\n- [ ] Seed data loaded (if needed)\n- [ ] SMTP configured for email magic links\n- [ ] OAuth providers configured (if using)\n- [ ] PWA icons generated (192x192 and 512x512 PNG)\n- [ ] Object storage configured (for brand assets)\n- [ ] Redis configured (for rate limiting in production)\n\n## Environment Variables\n\nRequired for production:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# App\nNODE_ENV=production\nNEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://your-domain.com\n\n# Database\nDATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@host:5432/dbname\n\n# Redis (recommended for production)\nREDIS_URL=redis://host:6379\n\n# Auth\nAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\nNEXTAUTH_URL=https://your-domain.com\nNEXTAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\n\n# OAuth (optional)\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_ID=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_TEAM_ID=\nAPPLE_KEY_ID=\n\n# Email\nSMTP_HOST=smtp.example.com\nSMTP_PORT=587\nSMTP_USER=noreply@your-domain.com\nSMTP_PASSWORD=\nSMTP_FROM=noreply@your-domain.com\n\n# Object Storage (S3 compatible)\nS3_ENDPOINT=\nS3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=\nS3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=\nS3_BUCKET=\nS3_REGION=\n\n# Platform Admin\nPLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS=admin@your-domain.com\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment Options\n\n### Vercel (Recommended)\n\n1. **Connect repository** to Vercel\n2. **Configure environment variables** in Vercel dashboard\n3. **Set build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Set output directory**: &#96;.next&#96;\n5. **Database**: Use Vercel Postgres or external provider\n6. **Redis**: Use Upstash Redis or external provider\n\n### Render\n\n1. **Create new Web Service**\n2. **Connect repository**\n3. **Build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Start command**: &#96;npm start&#96;\n5. **Environment**: Add all environment variables\n6. **Database**: Create PostgreSQL service\n7. **Redis**: Create Redis service (optional)\n\n### Fly.io\n\n1. **Install Fly CLI**: &#96;curl -L https://fly.io/install.sh | sh&#96;\n2. **Login**: &#96;fly auth login&#96;\n3. **Launch**: &#96;fly launch&#96;",

        "contents": "# Testing Guide - MVP Done Definition\n\nThis guide walks through all 8 steps of the MVP \"done definition\" to verify the platform works end-to-end.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Database is seeded: &#96;npm run db:seed&#96;\n2. Development server is running: &#96;npm run dev&#96;\n3. You have two browser windows/tabs (one for referrer, one for friend)\n\n## Test Data\n\nAfter seeding, you should have:\n- **Merchant**: Coffee House (slug: &#96;coffee-house&#96;)\n- **Admin user**: &#96;admin@coffee-house.com&#96;\n- **Regular user**: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n- **Vouchers**: At least one published voucher\n\n## Step-by-Step Test Flow\n\n### Step 1: Open Voucher Page ✅\n\n1. **Find a voucher ID** from the database:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n   SELECT id, \"codePrefix\" FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Open voucher page**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Should load without login\n   - Should show merchant branding\n   - Should display voucher value clearly\n   - Should have \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" button (if logged in)\n\n**Expected**: Voucher page loads in &lt;3 seconds, shows value, merchant brand visible.\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Create Referral ✅\n\n1. **Login as user**:\n   - Go to &#96;http://localhost:3000/login&#96;\n   - Use email: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n   - Check email for magic link (or use OAuth if configured)\n\n2. **Open voucher page** (from Step 1)\n\n3. **Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"**:\n   - Should create referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n   - Should generate share URL: &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n   - Should show native share sheet or copy link\n\n**Expected**: Referral created, share URL generated, link can be copied/shared.\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Share Link ✅\n\n1. **Copy the referral link** from Step 2\n   - Format: &#96;http://localhost:3000/r/[referralId]&#96;\n\n2. **Verify link is shareable**:\n   - Can be copied to clipboard\n   - Native share works (if on mobile/PWA)\n\n**Expected**: Link is valid and shareable.\n\n---\n\n### Step 4: Friend Redeems Voucher ✅\n\n1. **Open referral link in incognito/private window**:\n   ",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "export async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: params.slug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_admin');\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createVoucherSchema.parse(body);\n\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.create({\n      data: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'draft',\n        ...data,\n        validFrom: new Date(data.validFrom),\n        validTo: new Date(data.validTo),\n        weeklyDropJson: data.weeklyDropJson ? JSON.stringify(data.weeklyDropJson) : Prisma.DbNull,\n        conditionsJson: data.conditionsJson ? JSON.stringify(data.conditionsJson) : Prisma.DbNull,\n        designJson: data.designJson ? JSON.stringify(data.designJson) : Prisma.DbNull,\n      },\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json(voucher);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error creating voucher:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function GET(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string } }\n) {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n\n### Referrals\n\n- &#96;POST /api/referrals/create&#96; - Create referral and get share URL\n\n### Redemptions\n\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions&#96; - Create redemption\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&#96; - Confirm redemption (staff)\n\n### Credits\n\n- &#96;GET /api/wallet/[merchantSlug]&#96; - Get credit balance\n- &#96;POST /api/credits/apply&#96; - Apply credit to order\n\n### Weekly Drop\n\n- &#96;POST /api/weekly-drop/claim&#96; - Claim weekly drop stock\n\n## Database Schema\n\nKey models:\n\n- &#96;Merchant&#96;: Tenant information\n- &#96;User&#96;: Platform users\n- &#96;MerchantMember&#96;: User-merchant relationships with roles\n- &#96;Voucher&#96;: Voucher definitions\n- &#96;Referral&#96;: Referral instances",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { checkReferralRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createReferralSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(), // optional identifier hint for friend\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { voucherId, friendHint } = createReferralSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check rate limit\n    const rateLimit = await checkReferralRateLimit(session.user.id);\n    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Hash friend identifier if provided\n    const friendHash = friendHint\n      ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n      : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n    // Create referral\n    const referral = await prisma.referral.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n        friendHash,\n        status: 'created',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Generate share URL\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json\n\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { applyCredit } from '@/lib/credits';\nimport { getMerchantBySlug } from '@/lib/tenant';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst applyCreditSchema = z.object({\n  merchantSlug: z.string(),\n  amount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { merchantSlug, amount, orderReference } = applyCreditSchema.parse(body);\n\n    const merchant = await getMerchantBySlug(merchantSlug);\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    const result = await applyCredit(session.user.id, merchant.id, amount, orderReference || '');\n\n    return NextResponse.json(result);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message === 'Insufficient credit balance') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error applying credit:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\weekly-drop\\claim\\route.ts",
        "range": {

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 112,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n\n\n    if (dayOfWeek !== weeklyDrop.dayOfWeek || now &lt; startTime || now &gt; endTime) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop not active' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Atomically check stock and create referral\n    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      // Count existing referrals for this voucher created in this drop window\n      const existingCount = await tx.referral.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          createdAt: {\n            gte: startTime,\n            lte: endTime,\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (existingCount &gt;= weeklyDrop.stock) {\n        throw new Error('Weekly drop sold out');\n      }\n\n      // Create referral\n      const friendHash = friendHint\n        ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n        : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n      const referral = await tx.referral.create({\n        data: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n          referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n          friendHash,\n          status: 'created',\n        },\n      });\n\n      return referral;\n    });\n\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${result.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      referralId: result.id,\n      shareUrl,\n      remaining: weeklyDrop.stock - 1, // Approximate\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message === 'Weekly drop sold out') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 409 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error claiming weekly drop:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\redemptions\\route.ts",
        "range": {

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 149,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n\n\n    // If there's a referral, create locked credit\n    if (data.referralId) {\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n        where: { id: data.referralId },\n        include: { referrer: true },\n      });\n\n      if (referral) {\n        // Calculate credit amount (for MVP, use a fixed percentage or voucher value)\n        let creditAmount = 0;\n        if (voucher.type === 'credit_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value;\n        } else if (voucher.type === 'fixed_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value; // Same as discount\n        } else {\n          // Percentage: give 10% of discount as credit (configurable)\n          creditAmount = Math.floor(data.discountApplied * 0.1);\n        }\n\n        if (creditAmount &gt; 0) {\n          const expiresAt = new Date();\n          expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + 60); // Default 60 days\n\n          await prisma.creditLedger.create({\n            data: {\n              merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n              userId: referral.referrerUserId,\n              amount: creditAmount,\n              currency: voucher.currency,\n              status: 'locked',\n              source: 'referral_redemption',\n              sourceId: redemption.id,\n              expiresAt,\n            },\n          });\n\n          // Update referral status\n          await prisma.referral.update({\n            where: { id: data.referralId },\n            data: { status: 'redeemed' },\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      redemptionId: redemption.id,\n      requiresConfirmation: data.method === 'in_store',\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error creating redemption:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\weekly-drop\\claim\\route.ts",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "column": 56
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 112,
            "column": 1
          }

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst claimSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { voucherId, friendHint } = claimSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher with weekly drop info\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: voucherId },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher || !voucher.weeklyDropEnabled) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found or weekly drop not enabled' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    const weeklyDrop = voucher.weeklyDropJson\n      ? (JSON.parse(voucher.weeklyDropJson as string) as {\n          dayOfWeek: number;\n          startTime: string;\n          stock: number;\n          durationMinutes: number;\n        })\n      : null;\n\n    if (!weeklyDrop) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop configuration missing' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check if we're in the drop window\n    const now = new Date();\n    const dayOfWeek = now.getDay();\n    const [hours, minutes] = weeklyDrop.startTime.split(':').map(Number);\n    const startTime = new Date(now);\n    startTime.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);\n    const endTime = new Date(startTime);\n    endTime.setMinutes(endTime.getMinutes() + weeklyDrop.durationMinutes);\n\n    if (dayOfWeek !== weeklyDrop.dayOfWeek || now &lt; startTime || now &gt; endTime)\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { ensureMerchantOwnership } from '@/lib/tenant';\n\nexport async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { id: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, voucher.merchantId, 'merchant_admin');\n\n    // Validate voucher can be published\n    if (voucher.status === 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher already published' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    if (!voucher.designJson) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher design is required' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Update status to published\n    const updated = await prisma.voucher.update({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n      data: { status: 'published' },\n    });\n\n    // Log audit\n    await prisma.auditLog.create({\n      data: {\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        actorUserId: session.user.id,\n        action: 'voucher.published',\n        payloadJson: JSON.stringify({ voucherId: params.id }),\n      },\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json(updated);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error publishing voucher:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Audit\n\n## ✅ MVP Pages (Required &amp; Present)\n\n### PUBLIC\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page  \n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n### USER\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ⚠️ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/vouchers&#96; - User vouchers (not explicitly in spec, but useful for flow B)\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo (required for flow F)\n\n### MERCHANT\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n## ⚠️ Non-MVP Pages (Present but Not in Scope)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in the MVP specification:\n\n1. **&#96;/admin&#96;** - Platform admin dashboard\n   - Status: Present, minimal implementation\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but document as internal-only\n\n2. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;** - Analytics dashboard\n   - Status: Present with charts/stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n3. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96;** - Referral analytics\n   - Status: Present with referral stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n4. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;** - Member management\n   - Status: Present, minimal\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but hide from navigation\n\n5. **&#96;/m/[slug]&#96;** - Public merchant landing page\n   - Status: Present, shows merchant vouchers\n   - Action: **REMOVE** - Not in MVP scope (spec says \"NO OTHER PAGES\")\n\n## ✅ Core Flows Verification\n\n### A) Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ Voucher builder at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n- ✅ Publish endpoint: &#96;/api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n### B) User shares voucher\n- ✅ Share button on &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n- ✅ Creates referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n- ✅ Generates share URL &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working",

        "contents": "export default function ReferralClient({\n  referral,\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isSelfReferral,\n}: ReferralClientProps) {\n\n\n  const handleRedeem = async (method: 'online' | 'in_store') =&gt; {\n    if (isSelfReferral) {\n      setError('You cannot redeem your own referral link');\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsRedeeming(true);\n    setError('');\n    try {\n      const amount = method === 'online' ? parseInt(orderAmount, 10) * 100 : 10000;\n      const discount = calculateDiscount(amount);\n      const response = await fetch('/api/redemptions', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          referralId: referral.id,\n          method,\n          amountBeforeDiscount: amount,\n          discountApplied: discount,\n          currency: voucher.currency,\n        }),\n      });\n      const data = await response.json();\n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Redemption failed');\n      if (method === 'in_store') {\n        showSuccess('Show the QR below to staff. Waiting for merchant confirmation.');\n        qrRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n      } else {\n        showSuccess(&#96;Discount applied: ${formatCurrency(discount, voucher.currency)}&#96;);\n      }\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err: unknown) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Redemption failed');\n    } finally {\n      setIsRedeeming(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const headline = design?.headline || 'Special Offer';\n  const fromName = referral.referrer?.name || 'a friend';\n  const scope = &#96;ref-${String(referral.id).replace(/\\s/g, '')}&#96;;\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className={&#96;${scope}\n}",

        "contents": "export default function VoucherClient({\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isAuthenticated,\n}: VoucherClientProps) {\n  const [isSharing, setIsSharing] = useState(false);\n  const [got, setGot] = useState(false);\n\n  const brandBg = brandColors?.background || design?.backgroundColor || '#fafafa';\n  const brandPrimary = brandColors?.primary || design?.primaryColor || '#18181b';\n\n  const handleGet = async () =&gt; {\n    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(voucherCode);\n    showSuccess('Voucher code copied');\n    setGot(true);\n    setTimeout(() =&gt; setGot(false), 1500);\n  };\n\n  const handleShare = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsSharing(true);\n    let url = window.location.href;\n    if (isAuthenticated) {\n      try {\n        const res = await fetch('/api/referrals/create', {\n          method: 'POST',\n          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n          body: JSON.stringify({ voucherId: voucher.id }),\n        });\n        const data = await res.json();\n        if (data.shareUrl) url = data.shareUrl;\n      } catch {\n        // use /v/ link as fallback\n      }\n    }\n    if (navigator.share) {\n      try {\n        await navigator.share({\n          title: design?.headline || 'Special Offer',\n          text: &#96;Check out this voucher from ${voucher.merchant.name}&#96;,\n          url,\n        });\n        showSuccess('Link shared');\n      } catch {\n        // cancelled or error\n      }\n    } else {\n      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);\n      showInfo('Link copied to clipboard');\n    }\n    setIsSharing(false);\n  };\n\n  const getVoucherValue = () =&gt; {\n    if (voucher.type === 'percentage') return formatPercentage(voucher.value);\n    return formatCurrency(voucher.value, voucher.currency);\n  };\n\n  const headline = design?.headline || 'Special Offer';\n  const limitText = voucher.usageLimitTotal\n    ? &#96; · First ${voucher.usageLimitTotal} uses&#96;\n    : '';\n\n  const scope = &#96;voucher-theme-${String(voucher.id).replace(/\\s/g, '')}&#96;;\n}",

        "contents": "export function VoucherRowActions({ slug, voucherId, status }: VoucherRowActionsProps) {\n\n\n  const handleDuplicate = async () =&gt; {\n    setDuplicating(true);\n    try {\n      const getRes = await fetch(&#96;/api/merchant/${slug}/vouchers/${voucherId}&#96;);\n      if (!getRes.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load voucher');\n      const v = await getRes.json();\n\n      const parse = (x: unknown) =&gt; (typeof x === 'string' ? JSON.parse(x) : x ?? undefined);\n      const designJson = v.designJson != null ? parse(v.designJson) : undefined;\n      const weeklyDropJson = v.weeklyDropJson != null ? parse(v.weeklyDropJson) : undefined;\n      const conditionsJson = v.conditionsJson != null ? parse(v.conditionsJson) : undefined;\n\n      const body = {\n        type: v.type,\n        value: v.value,\n        currency: v.currency,\n        validFrom: new Date(v.validFrom).toISOString(),\n        validTo: new Date(v.validTo).toISOString(),\n        usageLimitTotal: v.usageLimitTotal ?? undefined,\n        usageLimitPerUser: v.usageLimitPerUser ?? undefined,\n        weeklyDropEnabled: v.weeklyDropEnabled ?? false,\n        weeklyDropJson: weeklyDropJson ?? undefined,\n        conditionsJson: conditionsJson ?? undefined,\n        designJson,\n        codePrefix: v.codePrefix ?? undefined,\n      };\n\n      const postRes = await fetch(&#96;/api/merchant/${slug}/vouchers&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify(body),\n      });\n      if (!postRes.ok) {\n        const d = await postRes.json().catch(() =&gt; ({}));\n        throw new Error(d.error || 'Failed to duplicate');\n      }\n      const created = await postRes.json();\n      showSuccess('Voucher duplicated');\n      router.push(&#96;/merchant/${slug}/vouchers/${created.id}&#96;);\n    } catch (e) {\n      showError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to duplicate');\n    } finally {\n      setDuplicating(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex items-center gap-1\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "# Testing Guide - MVP Done Definition\n\nThis guide walks through all 8 steps of the MVP \"done definition\" to verify the platform works end-to-end.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Database is seeded: &#96;npm run db:seed&#96;\n2. Development server is running: &#96;npm run dev&#96;\n3. You have two browser windows/tabs (one for referrer, one for friend)\n\n## Test Data\n\nAfter seeding, you should have:\n- **Merchant**: Coffee House (slug: &#96;coffee-house&#96;)\n- **Admin user**: &#96;admin@coffee-house.com&#96;\n- **Regular user**: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n- **Vouchers**: At least one published voucher\n\n## Step-by-Step Test Flow\n\n### Step 1: Open Voucher Page ✅\n\n1. **Find a voucher ID** from the database:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n   SELECT id, \"codePrefix\" FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Open voucher page**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Should load without login\n   - Should show merchant branding\n   - Should display voucher value clearly\n   - Should have \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" button (if logged in)\n\n**Expected**: Voucher page loads in &lt;3 seconds, shows value, merchant brand visible.\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Create Referral ✅\n\n1. **Login as user**:\n   - Go to &#96;http://localhost:3000/login&#96;\n   - Use email: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n   - Check email for magic link (or use OAuth if configured)\n\n2. **Open voucher page** (from Step 1)\n\n3. **Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"**:\n   - Should create referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n   - Should generate share URL: &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n   - Should show native share sheet or copy link\n\n**Expected**: Referral created, share URL generated, link can be copied/shared.\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Share Link ✅\n\n1. **Copy the referral link** from Step 2\n   - Format: &#96;http://localhost:3000/r/[referralId]&#96;\n\n2. **Verify link is shareable**:\n   - Can be copied to clipboard\n   - Native share works (if on mobile/PWA)\n\n**Expected**: Link is valid and shareable.\n\n---\n\n### Step 4: Friend Redeems Voucher ✅\n\n1. **Open referral link in incognito/private window**:\n   ",

        "contents": "  @@unique([merchantId, userId])\n  @@index([merchantId])\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel Campaign {\n  id              String   @id @default(cuid())\n  merchantId      String\n  name            String\n  description     String?\n  type            String   // weekly | limited\n  startDate       DateTime\n  endDate         DateTime\n  price           Int?     // minor units, null = free\n  discountRules   Json?    // { type, value, currency }\n  maxRedemptions  Int?\n  maxPurchases    Int?\n  terms           String?\n  creditPercentage Int?    // % of purchase price as credit (basis points, e.g. 500 = 5%)\n  status          String   @default(\"draft\") // draft | active | ended\n  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt\n\n  merchant Merchant @relation(fields: [merchantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  vouchers Voucher[]\n  purchases VoucherPurchase[]\n\n  @@index([merchantId])\n  @@index([status])\n  @@index([startDate, endDate])\n}\n\nmodel Voucher {\n  id                String   @id @default(cuid())\n  merchantId        String\n  campaignId        String?\n  status            String   @default(\"draft\") // draft | published | paused | ended\n  type              String   // percentage | fixed_amount | credit_amount\n  value             Int      // minor units for money, basis points for percentage\n  currency          String\n  validFrom         DateTime\n  validTo           DateTime\n  usageLimitTotal   Int?\n  usageLimitPerUser Int?\n  weeklyDropEnabled Boolean  @default(false)\n  weeklyDropJson    Json?\n  conditionsJson    Json?\n  designJson        Json?\n  codePrefix        String?\n  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt",

        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

        "contents": "# How to Add a New Merchant Currency\n\nMerchants can use any ISO 4217 currency code. The system supports all currencies that JavaScript's &#96;Intl.NumberFormat&#96; supports.\n\n## Adding Currency Support\n\n1. **Set merchant currency**:\n   When creating or updating a merchant, set the &#96;defaultCurrency&#96; field to the ISO 4217 code (e.g., \"EUR\", \"GBP\", \"JPY\").\n\n2. **Currency formatting**:\n   The &#96;formatCurrency&#96; function in &#96;lib/utils.ts&#96; automatically formats currencies using the browser's locale-aware formatting:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   formatCurrency(5000, 'EUR') // \"€50.00\" (in en-US locale)\n   formatCurrency(5000, 'JPY') // \"¥50\" (no decimals for JPY)\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Database storage**:\n   All monetary amounts are stored in minor units (cents for USD, pence for GBP, etc.):\n   - USD: $5.00 = 500 (minor units)\n   - EUR: €5.00 = 500 (minor units)\n   - JPY: ¥50 = 50 (no minor units)\n\n4. **Voucher creation**:\n   When creating a voucher, specify the currency:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;json\n   {\n     \"type\": \"fixed_amount\",\n     \"value\": 500,  // in minor units\n     \"currency\": \"EUR\"\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supported Currencies\n\nAll ISO 4217 currencies are supported. Common examples:\n- USD (US Dollar)\n- EUR (Euro)\n- GBP (British Pound)\n- JPY (Japanese Yen)\n- CAD (Canadian Dollar)\n- AUD (Australian Dollar)\n- CHF (Swiss Franc)\n- CNY (Chinese Yuan)\n\n## Currency Conversion\n\nThe platform does NOT handle currency conversion. Each merchant operates in a single currency. If you need multi-currency support with conversion, you would need to:\n1. Add a currency conversion service (e.g., ExchangeRate API)\n2. Store exchange rates\n3. Convert amounts at redemption time",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# How to Add a New Merchant Currency",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "Merchants can use any ISO 4217 currency code. The system supports all currencies that JavaScript's &#96;Intl.NumberFormat&#96; supports.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## Adding Currency Support",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Set merchant currency**:",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "   When creating or updating a merchant, set the &#96;defaultCurrency&#96; field to the ISO 4217 code (e.g., \"EUR\", \"GBP\", \"JPY\").",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Currency formatting**:",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "   The &#96;formatCurrency&#96; function in &#96;lib/utils.ts&#96; automatically formats currencies using the browser's locale-aware formatting:",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "   formatCurrency(5000, 'EUR') // \"€50.00\" (in en-US locale)",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "   formatCurrency(5000, 'JPY') // \"¥50\" (no decimals for JPY)",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Database storage**:",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "   All monetary amounts are stored in minor units (cents for USD, pence for GBP, etc.):",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "   - USD: $5.00 = 500 (minor units)",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "   - EUR: €5.00 = 500 (minor units)",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "   - JPY: ¥50 = 50 (no minor units)",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Voucher creation**:",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "   When creating a voucher, specify the currency:",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "   {",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "     \"type\": \"fixed_amount\",",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "     \"value\": 500,  // in minor units",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "     \"currency\": \"EUR\"",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "   }",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "## Supported Currencies",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "All ISO 4217 currencies are supported. Common examples:",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- USD (US Dollar)",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "- EUR (Euro)",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "- GBP (British Pound)",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "- JPY (Japanese Yen)",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- CAD (Canadian Dollar)",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- AUD (Australian Dollar)",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "- CHF (Swiss Franc)",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- CNY (Chinese Yuan)",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "## Currency Conversion",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "The platform does NOT handle currency conversion. Each merchant operates in a single currency. If you need multi-currency support with conversion, you would need to:",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Add a currency conversion service (e.g., ExchangeRate API)",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Store exchange rates",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Convert amounts at redemption time",
            "lineNumber": 50
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.1775992512702942

prisma.voucherPurchase.aggregate\n\n;\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Format date with locale support\n */\nexport function formatDateWithLocale(\n  date: Date | string,\n  locale?: string,\n  options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions\n): string {\n  const dateObj = typeof date === 'string' ? new Date(date) : date;\n  const localeCode = locale || 'en-US';\n  const defaultOptions: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = {\n    year: 'numeric',\n    month: 'long',\n    day: 'numeric',\n    ...options,\n  };\n  \n  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(localeCode, defaultOptions).format(dateObj);\n}\n\n/**\n * Get locale-specific currency symbol\n */\nexport function getCurrencySymbol(currency: string, locale?: string): string {\n  const localeCode = locale || 'en-US';\n}",

        "contents": "export default getRequestConfig(async ({ requestLocale }) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const locale = await requestLocale;\n    if (!locale || !locales.includes(locale as Locale)) notFound();\n\n    const base = (await import('./messages/en.json')).default as Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;;\n    const loc = (await import(&#96;./messages/${locale}.json&#96;)).default as Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;;\n    const merged: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt; = { ...loc };\n    for (const k of Object.keys(base)) {\n      if (!(k in merged)) merged[k] = base[k];\n    }\n\n    return {\n      locale,\n      messages: merged as AbstractIntlMessages,\n      timeZone: 'UTC',\n    };\n  } catch (err) {\n    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development')\n};",

        "contents": "# Täiustuste kokkuvõte\n\n## ✅ Valmis täiustused\n\n### 1. Toast Notifications System\n- ✅ Radix UI toast komponendid\n- ✅ Success, error, info variandid\n- ✅ Auto-dismiss funktsioon\n- ✅ Helper funktsioonid (&#96;showSuccess&#96;, &#96;showError&#96;, &#96;showInfo&#96;)\n- ✅ Integreeritud root layout'is\n\n### 2. Loading States\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent spinner'iga\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; komponent loading state'ide jaoks\n- ✅ Näide kasutamisest &#96;publish-button.tsx&#96;'is\n\n### 3. Analytics Dashboard\n- ✅ Uus analytics leht (&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;)\n- ✅ Total redemptions, revenue, credits issued\n- ✅ Top vouchers statistika\n- ✅ Recent redemptions list\n- ✅ Link dashboard'ist\n\n### 4. UI Komponendid\n- ✅ &#96;Select&#96; komponent (Radix UI)\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; loading komponent\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent\n- ✅ &#96;Toast&#96; süsteem\n\n## 📋 Järgmised sammud (valikuline)\n\n### Prioriteet 1\n1. **Asendada kõik alert() kutsed toast'idega**\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/redemptions/confirm-button.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n\n2. **Voucher otsing ja filtreerimine**\n   - Otsing välja\n   - Filtreerimine staatuse, tüübi, kuupäeva järgi\n   - Sortimine\n\n3. **Parem error handling UI**\n   - Error boundaries\n   - Retry mechanisms\n\n### Prioriteet 2\n4. **Email notifications**\n   - Credit unlock notifications\n   - Redemption confirmations\n   - Weekly drop reminders\n\n5. **Voucher mallid**\n   - Eeldefineeritud mallid\n   - Mallide salvestamine\n   - Kiire loomine\n\n6. **Export funktsioonid**\n   - CSV export redemptions\n   - Credits ledger export\n\n### Prioriteet 3\n7. **Graafikud ja visualisatsioonid**\n   - Chart.js või Recharts integratsioon\n   - Time-series graafikud\n   - Conversion funnels\n\n8. **Bulk operations**\n   - Mitme voucher'i korraga avaldamine\n   - CSV import\n\n## 🚀 Kuidas kasutada",

        "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise juhend\n\n## Toetatud keeled\n\nPlatvorm toetab praegu järgmisi keeli:\n- **en** - English (inglise)\n- **et** - Eesti (eesti)\n- **es** - Español (hispaania)\n- **fr** - Français (prantsuse)\n- **de** - Deutsch (saksa)\n\n## Kuidas see töötab\n\n### 1. URL struktuur\n\n- Inglise (vaikimisi): &#96;/v/[id]&#96; või &#96;/en/v/[id]&#96;\n- Eesti: &#96;/et/v/[id]&#96;\n- Hispaania: &#96;/es/v/[id]&#96;\n- jne.\n\n### 2. Keele valik\n\nKeele valija on kõikjal lehe ülaosas paremal. Kasutaja saab valida keele, mis rakendatakse kogu platvormile.\n\n### 3. Tõlked\n\nKõik tõlked on &#96;messages/[locale].json&#96; failides. Struktuur on järgmine:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"common\": { ... },\n  \"voucher\": { ... },\n  \"merchant\": { ... },\n  \"wallet\": { ... },\n  ...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Kuidas kasutada tõlkeid\n\n### Server Components\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n\nexport default function MyPage() {\n  const t = useTranslations('common');\n  return &lt;h1&gt;{t('welcome')}&lt;/h1&gt;;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Client Components\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n'use client';\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n\nexport default function MyComponent() {\n  const t = useTranslations('voucher');\n  return &lt;button&gt;{t('share')}&lt;/button&gt;;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Linkide kasutamine\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { Link } from '@/routing';\n\n&lt;Link href=\"/vouchers\"&gt;Vouchers&lt;/Link&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSee tagab, et link säilitab praeguse keele.\n\n## Uue keele lisamine\n\n1. **Lisa keel konfiguratsiooni**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // i18n.ts\n   export const locales = ['en', 'et', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'fi'] as const;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Lisa keel routing'usse**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // routing.ts\n   locales: ['en', 'et', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'fi']\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Loo tõlke fail**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cp messages/en.json messages/fi.json\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **Tõlgi kõik stringid** &#96;messages/fi.json&#96; failis.\n\n5. **Lisa keele nimi**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",

session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) {\n    redirect('/login');\n  }\n\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n    where: { slug: params.slug },\n  });\n\n  if (!merchant) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n  // Get analytics data\n  const [\n    totalRedemptions,\n    totalRevenue,\n    totalCreditsIssued,\n    topVouchers,\n    recentRedemptions,\n  ] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        confirmedAt: { not: null },\n      },\n    }),\n    prisma.redemption.aggregate({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        confirmedAt: { not: null },\n      },\n      _sum: {\n        discountApplied: merchantId: merchant.id,\n        confirmedAt: { not: null },\n      },\n      include: {\n        voucher: {\n          select: { id: true, type: true },\n        },\n      },\n      orderBy: { confirmedAt: 'desc' },\n      take: 10,\n    }),\n  ]);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen p-4\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "export default function VoucherClient({\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isAuthenticated,\n}: VoucherClientProps) {\n  const [isSharing, setIsSharing] = useState(false);\n  const [got, setGot] = useState(false);\n\n  const brandBg = brandColors?.background || design?.backgroundColor || '#fafafa';\n  const brandPrimary = brandColors?.primary || design?.primaryColor || '#18181b';\n\n  const handleGet = async () =&gt; {\n    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(voucherCode);\n    showSuccess('Voucher code copied');\n    setGot(true);\n    setTimeout(() =&gt; setGot(false), 1500);\n  };\n\n  const handleShare = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsSharing(true);\n    let url = window.location.href;\n    if (isAuthenticated) {\n      try {\n        const res = await fetch('/api/referrals/create', {\n          method: 'POST',\n          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n          body: JSON.stringify({ voucherId: voucher.id }),\n        });\n        const data = await res.json();\n        if (data.shareUrl) url = data.shareUrl;\n      } catch {\n        // use /v/ link as fallback\n      }\n    }\n    if (navigator.share) {\n      try {\n        await navigator.share({\n          title: design?.headline || 'Special Offer',\n          text: &#96;Check out this voucher from ${voucher.merchant.name}&#96;,\n          url,\n        });\n        showSuccess('Link shared');\n      } catch {\n        // cancelled or error\n      }\n    } else {\n      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);\n      showInfo('Link copied to clipboard');\n    }\n    setIsSharing(false);\n  };\n\n  const getVoucherValue = () =&gt; {\n    if (voucher.type === 'percentage') return formatPercentage(voucher.value);\n    return formatCurrency(voucher.value, voucher.currency);\n  };\n\n  const headline = design?.headline || 'Special Offer';\n  const limitText = voucher.usageLimitTotal\n    ? &#96; · First ${voucher.usageLimitTotal} uses&#96;\n    : '';\n\n  const scope = &#96;voucher-theme-${String(voucher.id).replace(/\\s/g, '')}&#96;;\n}",

`.next` kaust on kustutatud. See peaks lahendama `@formatjs` mooduli viga, mis oli põhjustatud Next.js build vahemälu probleemist.

**Tehtud:**
- `.next` kaust on kustutatud (build vahemälu on tühjendatud)

**Järgmised sammud:**
1. Taaskäivitage arendusserver (kui see jookseb):
   ```powershell
   npm run dev
   ```
   või
   ```powershell
   npm run dev:full
   ```

2. Kui viga püsib, proovige:
   ```powershell
   npm install
   ```
   See tagab, et kõik `@formatjs` paketid (mis on `next-intl` sõltuvused) on korrektselt installitud.

**Selgitus:**
- `@formatjs` paketid on `next-intl` sõltuvused (kasutatakse i18n funktsionaalsuse jaoks)
- Viga tekkis, kuna Next.js build vahemälu oli korruptunud
- `.next` kausta kustutamine sunnib Next.js-i kõik uuesti ehitama

**Tehtud:**
1. Peatatud kõik Node.js protsessid (sh dev server)
2. Kustutatud `.next` kaust

**Järgmised sammud:**
Taaskäivitage arendusserver:

```powershell
npm run dev
```

või täielikuks käivitamiseks:

        "contents": "# How to Add a New Locale\n\nThe platform uses &#96;next-intl&#96; for internationalization. Currently, English (&#96;en&#96;) is the default locale.\n\n## Adding a New Locale\n\n1. **Add locale to configuration**:\n   Edit &#96;i18n.ts&#96; and add your locale to the &#96;locales&#96; array:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   export const locales = ['en', 'es', 'fr'] as const;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Create translation file**:\n   Create &#96;messages/[locale].json&#96; (e.g., &#96;messages/es.json&#96;) with translations:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;json\n   {\n     \"common\": {\n       \"welcome\": \"Bienvenido\",\n       \"loading\": \"Cargando...\",\n       \"error\": \"Error\",\n       \"success\": \"Éxito\"\n     },\n     \"voucher\": {\n       \"share\": \"Compartir Cupón\",\n       \"redeem\": \"Canjear\",\n       \"expired\": \"Expirado\"\n     }\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Update middleware** (if needed):\n   The middleware can detect locale from headers or URL segments. Update &#96;middleware.ts&#96; if you want locale-based routing.\n\n4. **Use translations in components**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n   \n   function MyComponent() {\n     const t = useTranslations('common');\n     return &lt;h1&gt;{t('welcome')}&lt;/h1&gt;;\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Locale Detection\n\nThe platform can detect locale from:\n- URL path prefix (e.g., &#96;/es/v/[id]&#96;)\n- Accept-Language header\n- User preference (stored in session)\n\n## Currency Formatting\n\nCurrency formatting is handled by &#96;formatCurrency&#96; in &#96;lib/utils.ts&#96;, which uses &#96;Intl.NumberFormat&#96;. The currency code comes from the merchant's &#96;defaultCurrency&#96; field.",

        "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise juhend\n\n## Toetatud keeled\n\nPlatvorm toetab praegu järgmisi keeli:\n- **en** - English (inglise)\n- **et** - Eesti (eesti)\n- **es** - Español (hispaania)\n- **fr** - Français (prantsuse)\n- **de** - Deutsch (saksa)\n\n## Kuidas see töötab\n\n### 1. URL struktuur\n\n- Inglise (vaikimisi): &#96;/v/[id]&#96; või &#96;/en/v/[id]&#96;\n- Eesti: &#96;/et/v/[id]&#96;\n- Hispaania: &#96;/es/v/[id]&#96;\n- jne.\n\n### 2. Keele valik\n\nKeele valija on kõikjal lehe ülaosas paremal. Kasutaja saab valida keele, mis rakendatakse kogu platvormile.\n\n### 3. Tõlked\n\nKõik tõlked on &#96;messages/[locale].json&#96; failides. Struktuur on järgmine:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"common\": { ... },\n  \"voucher\": { ... },\n  \"merchant\": { ... },\n  \"wallet\": { ... },\n  ...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Kuidas kasutada tõlkeid\n\n### Server Components\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n\nexport default function MyPage() {\n  const t = useTranslations('common');\n  return &lt;h1&gt;{t('welcome')}&lt;/h1&gt;;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Client Components\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n'use client';\nimport { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n\nexport default function MyComponent() {\n  const t = useTranslations('voucher');\n  return &lt;button&gt;{t('share')}&lt;/button&gt;;\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Linkide kasutamine\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { Link } from '@/routing';\n\n&lt;Link href=\"/vouchers\"&gt;Vouchers&lt;/Link&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSee tagab, et link säilitab praeguse keele.\n\n## Uue keele lisamine\n\n1. **Lisa keel konfiguratsiooni**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // i18n.ts\n   export const locales = ['en', 'et', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'fi'] as const;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Lisa keel routing'usse**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // routing.ts\n   locales: ['en', 'et', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'fi']\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Loo tõlke fail**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cp messages/en.json messages/fi.json\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **Tõlgi kõik stringid** &#96;messages/fi.json&#96; failis.\n\n5. **Lisa keele nimi**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",

        "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise staatus\n\n## ✅ Valmis\n\n1. **i18n konfiguratsioon**\n   - ✅ 5 keelt: en, et, es, fr, de\n   - ✅ Routing konfiguratsioon\n   - ✅ Middleware locale detection'iga\n\n2. **Tõlked**\n   - ✅ Inglise (en) - täielik\n   - ✅ Eesti (et) - täielik\n   - ✅ Hispaania (es) - täielik\n   - ✅ Prantsuse (fr) - täielik\n   - ✅ Saksa (de) - täielik\n\n3. **Komponendid**\n   - ✅ Language selector\n   - ✅ Locale-aware layout\n   - ✅ i18n utilities (valuuta, kuupäevad)\n\n4. **Dokumentatsioon**\n   - ✅ I18N_GUIDE.md - täielik juhend\n\n## ⚠️ Vajab täiendamist\n\n### 1. Olemasolevate lehtede migreerimine\n\nPraegu on palju lehti, mis ei kasuta tõlkeid.         "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { useLocale } from 'next-intl';\nimport { usePathname, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';\nimport { Globe } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { locales } from '@/i18n';\n\nconst languageNames: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n  en: 'English',\n  et: 'Eesti',\n  es: 'Español',\n  fr: 'Français',\n  de: 'Deutsch',\n  fi: 'Suomi',\n  sv: 'Svenska',\n  no: 'Norsk',\n  da: 'Dansk',\n  lv: 'Latviešu',\n  lt: 'Lietuvių',\n  pl: 'Polski',\n  uk: 'Українська',\n};\n\nexport default function LanguageSelector() {\n  const locale = useLocale();\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const pathname = usePathname();\n\n  const handleLanguageChange = (newLocale: string) =&gt; {\n    const pathWithoutLocale = pathname.replace(/^\\/[a-z]{2}(\\/|$)/, '/');\n    const newPath = newLocale === 'en'\n      ? pathWithoutLocale\n      : &#96;/${newLocale}${pathWithoutLocale}&#96;;\n    router.push(newPath);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\"&gt;\n      &lt;Globe className=\"h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground\" /&gt;\n      &lt;Select value={locale} onValueChange={handleLanguageChange}&gt;\n        &lt;SelectTrigger className=\"w-[140px]\"&gt;\n          &lt;SelectValue&gt;\n            {languageNames[locale] || locale}\n          &lt;/SelectValue&gt;\n        &lt;/SelectTrigger&gt;\n        &lt;SelectContent&gt;\n          {locales.map((loc) =&gt; (\n            &lt;SelectItem key={loc} value={loc}&gt;\n              {languageNames[loc] || loc}\n            &lt;/SelectItem&gt;\n          ))}\n        &lt;/SelectContent&gt;\n      &lt;/Select&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; - Public merchant page (should be removed per spec)\n\n### UI Look &amp; Feel\n- ✅ Premium, calm, confident design\n- ✅ Mobile-first responsive\n- ✅ One primary CTA per screen\n- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s",
